Legal

Data Processing Agreement

Last updated: 6 September 2026

Data processing under your agreement

enterlabs processes documents under a written agreement with each Client. The applicable Data Processing Agreement sets out the parties' roles, processing instructions, security measures, subprocessors, transfer arrangements and obligations for handling personal data.

This page is an overview. It does not replace a signed DPA, amend its terms or create a new processing authorisation.

Roles and processing

For platform services, Confluidity acts on the Client's documented instructions. The applicable agreement records the parties' data-protection roles, including whether the Client acts as a controller or on behalf of another organisation. Processing may include document handling, extraction, validation, redaction, analysis and presentation of results for human review.

Documents may contain personal and other sensitive information, including identity, policy, treatment and health information where those appear in the Client's files, and account or activity information about Authorised Users. Removing direct identifiers does not necessarily make data anonymous.

Any additional processing purpose, including benchmarking or model development, must be addressed in the applicable agreement with the corresponding data-protection roles and safeguards. This overview does not authorise that processing.

Deployment and service providers

Managed hosting uses AWS Jakarta, with disaster-recovery resources in Singapore. Hybrid deployments keep designated processing within the Client's environment. External services and transfer arrangements are addressed in the applicable agreement and Subprocessor List.

Security and assistance

Our ISO/IEC 27001:2022 information security management system supports access management, environment segregation, security monitoring and incident handling. We assist Clients with data-subject requests and other processing-related obligations under their agreements.

Incidents

We notify affected Clients without undue delay in accordance with applicable law and their agreements, and provide information and assistance as the investigation develops. Specific notification deadlines in a Client's agreement continue to apply.

Return and deletion

Return and deletion follow the Client's instructions, the applicable agreement and relevant retention requirements. These arrangements cover primary records, temporary files, logs and backup copies, with any required legal retention handled separately. Written confirmation of return or deletion is provided as required by the applicable agreement.

Client-specific deadlines and any separately agreed treatment of model parameters remain governed by the signed agreement. No universal deletion deadline is introduced by this overview.

Obtain the applicable DPA

Contact sales@enterlabs.ai to request the DPA applicable to your engagement. Supporting security documentation is available through our Trust page, subject to an access request and signed NDA.
